description: This is a Perl script designed for flashing firmware onto D-Link DSL-G6x4T devices via network protocols. It includes functions for device discovery over UDP, FTP-based firmware upload, and device reboot. The script contains specific logic for device identification, network communication, and firmware transfer procedures.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP customized to handle specific commands and responses needed for firmware management and device control of ADAM2 devices, including environment variable retrieval, reboot, and check functions.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends USER command with necessary arguments to initiate login.

methods.name: _PASV
methods.description: Requests passive mode operation from FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the FTP server, such as device identifiers and firmware info.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables using _GETENV.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends reboot command to the device via FTP.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Initiates device reboot, then closes FTP connection.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a flash check on the device, verifying firmware integrity.
